title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech - Delivery Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência e acompanhamento de profissionais alocados


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime remoto.


Regime de Contratação CLT


Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos :

* Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian

* Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success.


Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

If you’re passionate about helping businesses grow , building strong client relationships , and delivering exceptional service , we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Marketing Ninjas team.

Requisitos:

  • Desejável ensino superior cursando em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Manutenção Industrial.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Domínio em Interpretação e atualização de diagramas elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Conhecimento em comandos elétricos e motores, em Subestações (13,8 e 69 kV) e em Ferramentas e equipamentos de medição elétrica.
  • Domínio Multiplicador em Manutenção elétrica e eletrônica.
  • Domínio Multiplicador em Interpretação e atualização de diagramas elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Domínio em Matriz de criticidade e gestão de ativos.
  • Conhecimento em Sistema ERP (ex: SAP).

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .NET and AI Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively

E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em uma multinacional global do setor de energia , com forte presença internacional e investimentos contínuos em tecnologia, inovação e transformação digital.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento e suporte em soluções SAP utilizando ABAP
  • Configuração e implementação de transportes SAP (TMS) entre ambientes
  • Execução de testes, validações e garantia de qualidade das entregas
  • Investigação e resolução de incidentes em aplicações SAP
  • Suporte a atividades de cutover e go-live (mock runs, dress rehearsals)
  • Atuação com aplicações relacionadas à estratégia de equipamentos (SAP APM / AsInt )
  • Colaboração com times globais e áreas de negócio
  • Garantia de estabilidade, performance e qualidade das soluções

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento SAP ABAP
  • Conhecimento em SAP Transport Framework (TMS)
  • Experiência com testes e qualidade em ambientes SAP

  • Experiência com suporte e troubleshooting em SAP
  • Inglês avançado

  • Participação em cutover e go-live
  • Experiência em ambientes globais

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Nice to have:

Early Careers Talent Acquisition Partner

Hudson Talent Solutions| Brazil (Remote)

Location: Brazil, Remote | Full-time


At Hudson Talent Solutions, we embrace curiosity, think differently, and shape the future of talent.


What You'll Do

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

O profissional será responsável por apoiar a implementação, sustentação e evolução da solução de Group Reporting, garantindo consistência dos dados financeiros, aderência às normas contábeis e compliance regulatório. Atuará em interface direta com áreas de Controladoria, Contabilidade e TI, contribuindo para a confiabilidade dos processos de fechamento e consolidação.

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em processos de consolidação financeira;
  • Experiência prática em fechamento contábil e reporte gerencial;
  • Experiência com configuração de regras de consolidação e eliminações intercompany;
  • Conhecimento em estruturas de consolidação (grupos e unidades consolidadas);

  • Experiência em validação, reconciliação e consistência de dados;
  • Vivência em interação com áreas de negócio (Controladoria e Contabilidade);

  • Português fluente.


Diferenciais:

  • Inglês para leitura de documentação e interação com times globais.


Formação e Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de consolidação financeira;
  • Vivência prática com SAP S/4HANA, especialmente no contexto financeiro;

Competências Comportamentais:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience of cloud and DevOps experience to join the core team of our U.S. client. In this role, you will work on both our client's and their clients' software products bridging the gap between development and operations. You will do so by leveraging your expertise in cloud technologies and DevOps principles to design, build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and applications.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines
  • Develop and implement automated CI/CD workflows
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize AI/ML models, services, and applications in production environments
  • Establish best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, reliability, and security
  • Build frameworks and tooling to streamline feature release velocity while maintaining system stability and compliance
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling (e.g., code generation, testing automation, AIOps) into DevOps workflows
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost efficiency across distributed systems
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system resilience
  • Advise on DevOps maturity, cloud architecture, and AI-enabled engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
  • Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer, LLM APIs) and their integration into workflows
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Experience with security best practices in cloud and DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, compliance)
  • Ability to design systems that balance delivery speed with reliability and governance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Principal .Net Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal .Net Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client is a globally established, product-led technology organisation currently undergoing a large-scale platform and security transformation. They offer an excellent salary package , great benefits , and a very good team environment . With low attrition and a solid, experienced team , they provide a nice working environment and strong career progression opportunities . Having partnered with them for several years, we’ve seen their consistent investment in people and technology.


They are hiring a senior technical leader with a strong blend of .NET expertise , IAM knowledge , and leadership experience . This role requires someone who can operate across architecture and hands-on delivery, guiding teams through a complex modernisation journey.

You should be confident working in Agile environments , engaging with global stakeholders, and translating high-level strategy into clear technical direction. Strong English communication is essential.


Core Responsibilities

You will lead the architectural evolution of a business-critical platform, focusing on improving scalability, security, and maintainability . This includes defining a modern target architecture and supporting the transition from legacy systems to cloud-ready solutions .

As a .NET expert , you will review existing C# codebases, identify risks, and guide refactoring aligned with modern standards. You will also take ownership of Identity & Access Management architecture , ensuring secure authentication and authorization aligned with OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT .

Collaboration is key — you will work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and infrastructure, while also supporting Agile delivery by translating architecture into clear technical tasks.

You will regularly communicate with senior stakeholders, providing clear updates on progress, risks, and technical decisions.


Key Skills Required

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET architecture (modern and legacy systems)
  • Proven expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • Solid understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT protocols
  • Experience with platform modernisation (cloud migration, refactoring, system upgrades)
  • Strong background in distributed and cloud-native architectures
  • Knowledge of APIs, microservices, and integration patterns
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum / Kanban) environments
  • Ability to translate architecture into technical deliverables (epics, user stories)
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication


Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale system transformation projects
  • Exposure to database modernisation and data architecture
  • Background in mentoring teams and setting engineering standards
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:


  • Garantir a disponibilidade, performance e escalabilidade de nossos serviços críticos, com foco em infraestrutura baseada em AWS EC2 (Windows Server e Linux).
  • Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e processos de automação para monitoramento, provisionamento, gestão de configuração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos.
  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2; Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2; Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx).
  • Experiência sólida com Jenkins, incluindo: Criação e gerenciamento de pipelines; Integração com diversas ferramentas (ex: Git, SonarQube, testes automatizados); Configuração de agentes e escalabilidade do Jenkins; Administração do Jenkins e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação e gestão de configuração como: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Puppet, Chef. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e alerta como: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de CI/CD além de Jenkins.
  • Experiência com Git.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Loyalty Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.

  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Principal .Net Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal .Net Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client is a globally established, product-led technology organisation currently undergoing a large-scale platform and security transformation. They offer an excellent salary package , great benefits , and a very good team environment . With low attrition and a solid, experienced team , they provide a nice working environment and strong career progression opportunities . Having partnered with them for several years, we’ve seen their consistent investment in people and technology.

O que esperar de nós

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um cliente multinacional de grande porte, com forte presença global e foco em transformação digital, modernização de sistemas e construção de soluções escaláveis em cloud .


Sobre os projetos

Os projetos envolvem a modernização de sistemas corporativos críticos, com forte integração entre aplicações, dados e ambientes em nuvem. De acordo com o squad, você poderá atuar em soluções voltadas a operações, supply chain, plataformas internas ou produtos orientados a dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações full stack utilizando .NET (C#) e frameworks modernos (React, Angular ou Vue)
  • Evolução e modernização de aplicações existentes, incluindo migração de tecnologias legadas para arquiteturas modernas em cloud
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizadas globalmente
  • Construção e consumo de APIs RESTful
  • Integração de dados com sistemas corporativos (como SAP) e atuação com pipelines de dados / ETL
  • Desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e estruturas em bancos SQL
  • Atuação com serviços em nuvem Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, APIs, bancos gerenciados, etc.)
  • Desenvolvimento com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança
  • Participação em projetos com arquitetura baseada em microserviços e, em alguns casos, serverless
  • Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD
  • Participação em cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Troubleshooting, debugging e otimização de performance
  • Colaboração com times globais (EUA e LATAM)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack
  • Forte conhecimento em C# / .NET (Core ou versões mais recentes)
  • Experiência com React, Angular ou Vue.js
  • Experiência com APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server / Azure SQL
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente Azure)

  • Node.js / TypeScript no backend

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Systems Administrator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead Java (INGLÊS AVANÇADO) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo: 100% Remoto.

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado.

Contratação: PJ.


Visão Geral:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Java Tech Lead altamente experiente para liderar o design, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações de nível corporativo. Essa função exige forte liderança técnica, experiência prática (hands-on) e capacidade de orientar equipes na construção de soluções escaláveis e de alta performance. O(a) profissional atuará como referência em boas práticas, decisões de arquitetura e melhoria contínua ao longo de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, além de se comunicar de forma eficaz com stakeholders e promover um ambiente colaborativo.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Liderar o design e o desenvolvimento de aplicações baseadas em Java/JEE em ambientes complexos

Fornecer liderança técnica, mentoria e orientação para equipes de desenvolvimento

Definir e garantir boas práticas de codificação, arquitetura e otimização de performance

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar soluções escaláveis e resilientes

Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com stakeholders, traduzindo conceitos técnicos em impacto de negócio

Garantir a confiabilidade dos sistemas por meio de observabilidade, monitoramento e ajustes de performance

Apoiar na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos complexos

Impulsionar a melhoria contínua nos processos de desenvolvimento, ferramentas e práticas da equipe


Qualificações Obrigatórias:

Experiência sólida em Java/JEE

Forte conhecimento em ambientes Linux e shell scripting

Expertise avançada em Oracle, PL/SQL e scripts SQL complexos

Experiência prática com Spring Framework, incluindo Spring Boot

Experiência com IDEs como JBoss Developer Studio e IntelliJ

Experiência sólida com ferramentas de observabilidade como Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana e Prometheus

Conhecimento em tecnologias de cloud, incluindo Cloud Foundry e Kubernetes


Habilidades Comportamentais:

Forte capacidade de liderança e mentoria de equipes

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto técnica quanto de negócio

Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas em ambientes de alta complexidade

Perfil proativo, com senso de dono e responsabilidade

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares e distribuídas

Adaptabilidade e resiliência em ambientes dinâmicos e em constante evolução

Boa organização e capacidade de priorização

Diferenciais

Experiência com a linguagem de programação Go.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Workday Adaptive Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Workday Adaptive Consultant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant

Rate: 30-50hr USD


Required Skills & Experience


Adaptive Planning Expertise


5+ years of hands‑on Workday Adaptive Planning experience, with direct ownership of model design and builds

Proven experience architecting and building (not just maintaining) Adaptive Planning solutions

Deep expertise with:


Dimensions, sheets, versions, and assumptions

Driver‑based and complex calculation logic

Performance tuning and model optimization



Integrations & Systems


Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP

Strong understanding of data structures, planning data flows, and integration best practices


Financial & Business Acumen


Strong understanding of financial planning and FP&A processes, including budgeting and forecasting

Experience supporting SaaS or recurring‑revenue business models strongly preferred

Ability to bridge the gap between technical configuration and financial outcomes


Collaboration & Communication


Comfortable working cross‑functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non‑technical stakeholders

Experience operating as a senior consultant, owning delivery and stakeholder relationships


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards

Background in multi‑entity or high‑growth organizations

Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments


Job Description


Overview

We are seeking a senior‑level, hands‑on Workday Adaptive Planning consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions.


Key Responsibilities


Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning

Develop and optimize complex models (dimensions, sheets, versions, driver‑based logic)

Design and support integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms

Partner with Finance, RevOps, and Data teams to translate planning needs into system solutions

Troubleshoot model and integration issues; improve performance and usability

Create documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support ongoing ownership

title: FullStack Shopify Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FullStack Shopify Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crimson Agility is a full-service e-commerce services firm with an in-depth understanding of leading e-commerce platforms and a broad set of design, development, integration, and digital marketing skills. As a company, we promote a culture that values success, fairness, excellence, and professional growth.


Crimson Agility is looking for a FullStack Shopify Developer . The successful candidate will value challenging and innovative projects and take pride in their work. In this role, you will participate on a team responsible for implementing Shopify solutions and developing innovative e-commerce solutions for our clients, following best practices.


This position is available to remote candidates located only within the United States or LATAM.


WE’LL NEED YOU TO

  • Develop and implement innovative features and functionality for e-commerce using Shopify
  • Collaborate with a team of passionate e-commerce professionals to deliver exceptional outcomes
  • Apply your expertise in Shopify, Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and API integrations to extend, enhance, and build great user experiences. For the backend we prefer experience in PHP but other languages like Ruby are also valid.
  • Understand e-commerce business requirements and convert them into a coherent design
  • Unit test and take accountability for the quality of your work


APPLY IF YOU

  • Want to grow into a consultant capable of taking challenges from scratch and advise U.S-based businesses
  • Want to work on a diversity of B2B and B2C projects in a wide range of industries like automotive, healthcare, sports & outdoors
  • Working with a talented team of consultants, developers, and project managers
  • Are excited to work on high-traffic, high-profile websites with complex requirements
  • Are looking for a company that places value on training and skills development
  • Want to develop a career in the fast-growing industry of e-commerce


YOU MUST HAVE

  • 3+ years of experience with Shopify in the frontend, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify's Liquid templating language, with a proven track record of designing responsive, visually appealing user interfaces.
  • 3+ years of experience with Shopify in the backend using languages such as PHP, Ruby, Node, etc ., including server-side logic, API integration, and database management with a focus on Shopify platform customization and app development.
  • Experience working in an Agency environment
  • Ambition and Conversational English (B2/C1)


IT’D BE A PLUS IF YOU HAD

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Any Shopify certification
  • Experience with BigCommerce


CRIMSON AGILITY OFFERS

  • Competitive Salaries (commensurate with experience, education, certifications, etc.)
  • Quarterly Team Bonuses
  • Quarterly Individual Bonuses
  • Training & Certifications
  • Opportunity to learn from some of the best E-Commerce Professionals in the industry
  • 18 Days of PTO + 5 Sick Days + 10 Paid Holidays
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance (For US-based talent)
  • 401K with Employer Match (For US-based talent)


OUR HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process is simple but complete and only has three steps:

  • Initial Interview with David Baier (Managing Partner) to check your cultural fit
  • Technical Interview with Ian Coast (Solutions Architect & Managing Partner)
  • Offer Letter

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Web Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um cliente multinacional de grande porte, com forte presença global e foco em transformação digital, modernização de sistemas e construção de soluções escaláveis em cloud .


Sobre os projetos

Os projetos envolvem a modernização de sistemas corporativos críticos, com forte integração entre aplicações, dados e ambientes em nuvem. De acordo com o squad, você poderá atuar em soluções voltadas a operações, supply chain, plataformas internas ou produtos orientados a dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações full stack utilizando .NET (C#) e frameworks modernos (React, Angular ou Vue)
  • Evolução e modernização de aplicações existentes, incluindo migração de tecnologias legadas para arquiteturas modernas em cloud
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizadas globalmente
  • Construção e consumo de APIs RESTful
  • Integração de dados com sistemas corporativos (como SAP) e atuação com pipelines de dados / ETL
  • Desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e estruturas em bancos SQL
  • Atuação com serviços em nuvem Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, APIs, bancos gerenciados, etc.)
  • Desenvolvimento com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança
  • Participação em projetos com arquitetura baseada em microserviços e, em alguns casos, serverless
  • Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD
  • Participação em cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Troubleshooting, debugging e otimização de performance
  • Colaboração com times globais (EUA e LATAM)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack
  • Forte conhecimento em C# / .NET (Core ou versões mais recentes)
  • Experiência com React, Angular ou Vue.js
  • Experiência com APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server / Azure SQL
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente Azure)
  • Inglês avançado



Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Node.js / TypeScript no backend
  • Azure Functions, App Services, API Management
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps)
  • Experiência com ETL, SAP ou integração de dados
  • Docker e microsserviços
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Experiência em times ágeis distribuídos
  • Noções de data engineering ou analytics


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Loyalty Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.

  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Consultor(a) de Estruturação de Cargos e Salários (PJ)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) de Estruturação de Cargos e Salários (PJ) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre o desafio

Buscamos um(a) profissional com experiência em estruturação de cargos e salários para conduzir um projeto estratégico de revisão e implementação da arquitetura organizacional da empresa.

Essa pessoa será responsável por organizar, padronizar e dar clareza às estruturas de cargos, trilhas de carreira e políticas de remuneração, garantindo maior equidade interna e competitividade com o mercado. Vaga temporária de 3 meses.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar diagnóstico da estrutura atual de cargos e salários
  • Mapear e descrever cargos (job descriptions) em conjunto com as lideranças
  • Criar e/ou revisar plano de cargos, salários e carreiras (PCCS)
  • Desenvolver tabelas salariais e faixas de remuneração
  • Conduzir análises de equidade interna e benchmarking de mercado
  • Apoiar na definição de políticas de remuneração fixa e variável
  • Estruturar critérios de progressão e movimentação interna
  • Apresentar recomendações estratégicas para diretoria/gestão
  • Apoiar na comunicação e implementação do projeto

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em estruturação de cargos e salários
  • Vivência com projetos de PCCS do zero ou reestruturação
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de avaliação de cargos (ex: Hay, Mercer, etc.)
  • Experiência com análise de mercado e construção de tabelas salariais
  • Excel avançado (ou ferramentas de análise de dados)
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em consultorias ou projetos múltiplos
  • Vivência em empresas em crescimento ou reestruturação
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de RH/People Analytics

Perfil comportamental

  • Autonomia e senso de dono
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de influenciar lideranças
  • Organização e foco em entrega
  • Visão crítica e orientada a solução

Entregáveis esperados (ao final dos 3 meses)

  • Estrutura de cargos definida e documentada
  • Tabela salarial estruturada e validada
  • Política de remuneração formalizada
  • Recomendações estratégicas para evolução do modelo

Observação

Projeto com alto impacto organizacional, ideal para profissionais que gostam de estruturar, organizar e deixar legado.

Profissionais experientes com mente empreendedora, postura de dono e atuação consultiva.

Remuneração agressiva acima do mercado.
