title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


About the Role

The Data Engineering team is a software-centric group responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems that power a large marketplace platform. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer who can take ownership of end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy role that goes beyond traditional data engineering, requiring strong architectural design and the ability to build robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, in addition to scalable data pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product, and Core Engineering teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that enhance the company’s data platform capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Own projects from requirements gathering through production deployment and monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong programming skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex data modeling and BigQuery performance optimization
  • Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations with APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, and project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform and/or Atlantis


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.

Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Charge Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Full-Charge Bookkeeper


Remote I Part-Time I 20 hrs/week


Salary: $8-9/hour with opportunity for performance-based bonuses & raises


Golden Home Access is a mission-driven and fast-growing company based in the San Francisco Bay Area.


The United States’ aging population is growing rapidly. 90% of seniors want to stay in their home instead of moving into a senior care facility. We install essential safety and mobility equipment like stairlifts and wheelchair ramps to help seniors stay in their homes longer.


We are hiring a Full-Charge Bookkeeper to manage our bookkeeping, job costing, and AR/AP. We have a growing remote global team, including the Head of Project Management to whom you would report to.


This is a hands-on execution role. You will be responsible for running our day-to-day financial operations. You will not be responsible for financial strategy or decision-making.


Responsibilities


  • Bookkeeping: Maintain clean, accurate books in QuickBooks. Record and categorize all transactions correctly. Complete bank and credit card reconciliations. Maintain consistency in financial reporting month over month.
  • Accounts Payable: Verify vendor invoices, schedule and process payments according to vendor terms.
  • Accounts Receivables: Monitor customer payments. Verify invoices and deposits are paid and correctly applied. Reconcile deposits to final invoices by job. Flag and resolve overdue balances and discrepancies.
  • Job Costing: Allocate labor and materials accurately to each job. Maintain job-level cost records and calculate gross margin per job.
  • Purchase Order Management: Create and enter all POs into the inventory management system.
  • Payroll Administration: Administer weekly payroll. Collect and validate timesheets. Verify payroll accuracy prior to submission.
  • Sales Tax: Track taxable and non-taxable revenue. Reconcile sales tax collected to accounting records. File and remit sales tax accurately and on time. Maintain documentation of filings and payments.
  • SOP Development: Assist in the development and formalization of all financial policies and procedures. 


You are a fit if

  • Hungry to invest in your career for the long-term and work alongside other high-performing teammates
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks
  • Organized with an extreme attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in an evolving startup business environment
  • Comfortable escalating discrepancies rather than making assumptions
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Care about helping improve the lives of the elderly and their families; can approach the job with care and empathy


As we grow, you’ll grow - in title, responsibilities, and compensation. We have a track record of consistently rewarding high performance.


We believe in hiring top tier talent, investing in their long-term professional development, and giving them the freedom to do what they do best.

Location: Brazil

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to join a software-centric data engineering team responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems. This role involves owning the end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong coding skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL, including complex data modeling and query optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations using APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform or Atlantis

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior Data Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to join a software-centric data engineering team responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems. This role involves owning the end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy position requiring strong expertise in building robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, as well as developing scalable data pipelines. You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product and Engineering teams to deliver advanced data platform capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Take projects from initial requirements gathering through to production deployment and proactive monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, ensuring reliability and long-term maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong coding skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL, including complex data modeling and query optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations using APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform or Atlantis

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Operations Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Charge Bookkeeper em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Full-Charge Bookkeeper


Remote I Part-Time I 20 hrs/week


Salary: $8-9/hour with opportunity for performance-based bonuses & raises


Golden Home Access is a mission-driven and fast-growing company based in the San Francisco Bay Area.


The United States’ aging population is growing rapidly. 90% of seniors want to stay in their home instead of moving into a senior care facility. We install essential safety and mobility equipment like stairlifts and wheelchair ramps to help seniors stay in their homes longer.


We are hiring a Full-Charge Bookkeeper to manage our bookkeeping, job costing, and AR/AP. We have a growing remote global team, including the Head of Project Management to whom you would report to.


This is a hands-on execution role. You will be responsible for running our day-to-day financial operations. You will not be responsible for financial strategy or decision-making.


Responsibilities


  • Bookkeeping: Maintain clean, accurate books in QuickBooks. Record and categorize all transactions correctly. Complete bank and credit card reconciliations. Maintain consistency in financial reporting month over month.
  • Accounts Payable: Verify vendor invoices, schedule and process payments according to vendor terms.
  • Accounts Receivables: Monitor customer payments. Verify invoices and deposits are paid and correctly applied. Reconcile deposits to final invoices by job. Flag and resolve overdue balances and discrepancies.
  • Job Costing: Allocate labor and materials accurately to each job. Maintain job-level cost records and calculate gross margin per job.
  • Purchase Order Management: Create and enter all POs into the inventory management system.
  • Payroll Administration: Administer weekly payroll. Collect and validate timesheets. Verify payroll accuracy prior to submission.
  • Sales Tax: Track taxable and non-taxable revenue. Reconcile sales tax collected to accounting records. File and remit sales tax accurately and on time. Maintain documentation of filings and payments.
  • SOP Development: Assist in the development and formalization of all financial policies and procedures. 


You are a fit if

  • Hungry to invest in your career for the long-term and work alongside other high-performing teammates
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks
  • Organized with an extreme attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in an evolving startup business environment
  • Comfortable escalating discrepancies rather than making assumptions
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Care about helping improve the lives of the elderly and their families; can approach the job with care and empathy


As we grow, you’ll grow - in title, responsibilities, and compensation. We have a track record of consistently rewarding high performance.


We believe in hiring top tier talent, investing in their long-term professional development, and giving them the freedom to do what they do best.

title: AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.

This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.

You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Data Analyst
description:

About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Operations Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Gerente de Inovação em Tecnologia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Inovação em Tecnologia em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Resumo da Função:

Buscamos um líder visionário e prático que respire Inovação para capitanear as oportunidades de transformação digital demandadas pelos nossos clientes e o mercado. O profissional irá definir soluções que utilizam o poder da Inteligência Artificial, a agilidade do Low-Code/No-Code para otimizar processos complexos, garantindo integrações fluidas e fluxos de trabalho eficientes.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Estratégia de Inovação: Liderar a adoção de tecnologias emergentes, com foco especial em IA Generativa e modelos preditivos aplicados ao negócio.
  • Desenvolvimento Ágil: Orquestrar o desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando ferramentas de Low-Code/No-Code para entregas rápidas e escaláveis.
  • Otimização de Processos: Mapear, desenhar e implementar fluxos de trabalho eficientes utilizando ferramentas de BPM e automação.
  • Integração de Ecossistemas: Garantir que diferentes sistemas conversem de forma harmoniosa.
  • Liderança Técnica: Atuar como líder da equipe, traduzindo desafios operacionais em especificações técnicas viáveis.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:


1. Inteligência Artificial & Data Science

  • Generative AI Service: Implementação de LLMs integrados às aplicações de negócio.
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Capacidade de conectar a IA aos dados proprietários da empresa para respostas precisas.
  • Serviços Cognitivos: Aplicação da inteligência artificial em tarefas como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional, análise de texto e tomada de decisão.
  • Agentes de IA: Desenvolvimento de Digital Assistants que automatizam o atendimento interno via BPM.


2. Integrações & Arquitetura

  • Integration: Criar fluxos ponta-a-ponta entre o ERP, bases on-premises e aplicações de terceiros.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Conhecimento em mensageria e gatilhos em tempo real para automação de processos.


3. Desenvolvimento Low-Code/No-Code

  • Criação de dashboards inteligentes e interfaces de usuário que consomem modelos de IA de forma nativa.
  • Foco em User Experience (UX) para garantir que a inovação seja adotada pelos usuários finais.
  • BPM e Workflow: Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de processos (BPMN 2.0) e ferramentas de automação de fluxo.


4. Plataformas

  • Experiência nos tópicos acima nas plataformas da Oracle e será um diferencial também na plataforma da Pipefy.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Inovação ou Transformação Digital.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de projetos de inovação tecnológica.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.
  • Habilidade em gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Inglês avançado para acompanhar tendências globais e parcerias internacionais.


Diferenciais:

  • Mindset Empreendedor: Capacidade de ver valor onde outros veem apenas processos.
  • Comunicação Influente: Habilidade para \"vender\" ideias de inovação para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Resiliência Técnica: Saber navegar pelas atualizações constantes do ecossistema cloud sem perder o foco na entrega.

O que oferecemos:

Atrativos de Infraestrutura e Autonomia:

  • Acesso a Sandbox: Acesso a um ambiente isolado para experimentação de novos serviços (IA, Blockchain, IoT) e preparação de PoCs.
  • Acesso Antecipado a Beta Programs: Participação em programas de Early Adopter para testar novas funcionalidades ou novos modelos de IA Generativa antes do lançamento geral.
  • Certificações e Eventos: Custeio de exames de certificação e ingressos para eventos locais.


Cultura de Inovação Prática:

  • Pesquisa: Estudo de novas tecnologias ou desenvolvimento de projetos paralelos que tragam eficiência à empresa.
  • Squads Multidisciplinares: Autonomia para montar times ágeis focados em \"missões\", unindo os diferentes perfis da equipe.


Benefícios de Carreira

  • Bônus por Resultado: Bônus anual atrelado aos resultados obtidos.
  • Trabalho Anywhere: Regime flexível de trabalho home-office/presencial.
  • Mentoria Executiva: Visibilidade direta com o C-Level para apresentar os resultados das iniciativas de inovação, posicionando o profissional como um líder estratégico.

  • Seller: Sempre buscando parcerias estratégicas com influencers 


O que você não vai fazer


Definir tese editorial (Founder escreve 1x/mês). Escrever roteiros de YouTube. Diagramar carrosséis (nossa designer faz). Gerenciar ads ou freelancers. Trabalhar com IA/Clone AI (fora do escopo).


Perfil


Obrigatório: mínimo 5 anos gerenciando Instagram profissional com comprovação verificável de perfis geridos (não aceitamos apenas link do perfil — precisa comprovar autoria real na Fase 1). Copywriting forte para redes sociais (você escreve, não adapta template). Confortável usando IA (Gemini/Claude) como apoio de produção. SEO básico de YouTube. Leitura de dashboard (Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio). Notion.

Essencial: execução inquebrável (100% de cadência, não 80%), atenção obsessiva a detalhe, baixo ego criativo, proatividade operacional, comunicação clara para passar briefing limpo para designer e editor.

Não aplique se: quer \"evoluir para estratégia\", precisa de flexibilidade criativa, ou precisa de micromanagement.


Remuneração


  • R$ 4.000/mês nos 60 dias de trial
  • R$ 6.000/mês após aprovação no gate Day 60
  • Bônus orgânico desde o Dia 1 (não-cumulativo por peça, exclui impulsionadas): 100k views = +R$100 · 500k views = +R$300 · 1M views = +R$3.000


Plano de carreira desenhado após Dia 120, baseado em evidência real de resultados.


Processo Seletivo


Fase 1 — Call breve com Head of CS (20min, não-paga). Fit cultural + filtro inicial. Você apresenta ao vivo 2-3 perfis de Instagram que gerenciou, com comprovação verificável (acesso admin no Meta Business Suite, menção pública do cliente, ou contrato). Sem comprovação = eliminação automática.

Fase 2 — Desafio tático pago (72h, R$200 a todos que entregarem). Plano de 14 dias para reverter o downranking ativo do @yuripereirario (dados reais compartilhados no briefing): diagnóstico + cronograma executável + copy + briefing de carrossel pilar + análise de 5 posts.

Fase 3 — Conversa + simulação ao vivo (45min com Founder + Growth Operations Manager). Fit cultural + simulação de cenário real.



Borderless Coding · Sede nos EUA (Wyoming) · Time remoto Brasil · EdTech global

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Data Platform Engineer (Pipelines & Vector Databases)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Platform Engineer (Pipelines & Vector Databases) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing technology company building scalable, data-intensive systems that power both product experiences and AI-driven capabilities. Their platform relies heavily on clean, structured, and reliable data to enable advanced features, automation, and intelligent decision-making.

They are investing in modern data infrastructure to support both core product functionality and emerging AI use cases , ensuring that data is accessible, accurate, and optimized for scale.


Role Overview

We are looking for a full-time (40 hours/week) Senior Data & AI Infrastructure Engineer to design and build the data backbone of our platform.

This role focuses on data pipelines, transformation, and infrastructure , ensuring that data from multiple sources is ingested, structured, and made reliable for both product and AI systems.

You will work in the EST time zone , collaborating with engineering teams to support scalable data systems and enable AI-driven functionality.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data pipelines across multiple sources
  • Design data processing, transformation, and storage systems
  • Create and maintain a canonical data layer
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability
  • Structure datasets for both product and AI use cases
  • Support vector databases and AI data workflows


Requirements

  • Strong experience in data engineering and pipeline development
  • Hands-on experience with Airflow, Dagster, dbt (or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling and transformation
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets
  • Ability to build scalable and reliable data systems


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, PgVector)
  • Familiarity with embeddings, retrieval systems, or AI data layers
  • Exposure to modern AI data tools (e.g., MindsDB)


What This Role Focuses On

  • Data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline reliability
  • Building structured, trusted datasets
  • Supporting AI and product systems with high-quality data


Key Traits

  • Strong attention to detail and data quality
  • Systems thinker with scalability mindset
  • Comfortable working with high-volume, complex data

title: Gerente de Inovação em Tecnologia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Inovação em Tecnologia em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Resumo da Função:

Buscamos um líder visionário e prático que respire Inovação para capitanear as oportunidades de transformação digital demandadas pelos nossos clientes e o mercado. O profissional irá definir soluções que utilizam o poder da Inteligência Artificial, a agilidade do Low-Code/No-Code para otimizar processos complexos, garantindo integrações fluidas e fluxos de trabalho eficientes.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Estratégia de Inovação: Liderar a adoção de tecnologias emergentes, com foco especial em IA Generativa e modelos preditivos aplicados ao negócio.
  • Desenvolvimento Ágil: Orquestrar o desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando ferramentas de Low-Code/No-Code para entregas rápidas e escaláveis.
  • Otimização de Processos: Mapear, desenhar e implementar fluxos de trabalho eficientes utilizando ferramentas de BPM e automação.
  • Integração de Ecossistemas: Garantir que diferentes sistemas conversem de forma harmoniosa.
  • Liderança Técnica: Atuar como líder da equipe, traduzindo desafios operacionais em especificações técnicas viáveis.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:


1. Inteligência Artificial & Data Science

  • Generative AI Service: Implementação de LLMs integrados às aplicações de negócio.
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Capacidade de conectar a IA aos dados proprietários da empresa para respostas precisas.
  • Serviços Cognitivos: Aplicação da inteligência artificial em tarefas como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional, análise de texto e tomada de decisão.
  • Agentes de IA: Desenvolvimento de Digital Assistants que automatizam o atendimento interno via BPM.


2. Integrações & Arquitetura

  • Integration: Criar fluxos ponta-a-ponta entre o ERP, bases on-premises e aplicações de terceiros.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Conhecimento em mensageria e gatilhos em tempo real para automação de processos.


3. Desenvolvimento Low-Code/No-Code

  • Criação de dashboards inteligentes e interfaces de usuário que consomem modelos de IA de forma nativa.
  • Foco em User Experience (UX) para garantir que a inovação seja adotada pelos usuários finais.
  • BPM e Workflow: Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de processos (BPMN 2.0) e ferramentas de automação de fluxo.


4. Plataformas

  • Experiência nos tópicos acima nas plataformas da Oracle e será um diferencial também na plataforma da Pipefy.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Inovação ou Transformação Digital.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de projetos de inovação tecnológica.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.
  • Habilidade em gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Inglês avançado para acompanhar tendências globais e parcerias internacionais.


Diferenciais:

  • Mindset Empreendedor: Capacidade de ver valor onde outros veem apenas processos.
  • Comunicação Influente: Habilidade para \"vender\" ideias de inovação para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Resiliência Técnica: Saber navegar pelas atualizações constantes do ecossistema cloud sem perder o foco na entrega.

O que oferecemos:

Atrativos de Infraestrutura e Autonomia:

  • Acesso a Sandbox: Acesso a um ambiente isolado para experimentação de novos serviços (IA, Blockchain, IoT) e preparação de PoCs.
  • Acesso Antecipado a Beta Programs: Participação em programas de Early Adopter para testar novas funcionalidades ou novos modelos de IA Generativa antes do lançamento geral.
  • Certificações e Eventos: Custeio de exames de certificação e ingressos para eventos locais.


Cultura de Inovação Prática:

  • Pesquisa: Estudo de novas tecnologias ou desenvolvimento de projetos paralelos que tragam eficiência à empresa.
  • Squads Multidisciplinares: Autonomia para montar times ágeis focados em \"missões\", unindo os diferentes perfis da equipe.


Benefícios de Carreira

  • Bônus por Resultado: Bônus anual atrelado aos resultados obtidos.
  • Trabalho Anywhere: Regime flexível de trabalho home-office/presencial.
  • Mentoria Executiva: Visibilidade direta com o C-Level para apresentar os resultados das iniciativas de inovação, posicionando o profissional como um líder estratégico.

  • Creator Research: 3 referências internacionais novas por semana no banco de creators.
  • Relatório semanal (toda sexta) com top/bottom performers.
  • Seller: Sempre buscando parcerias estratégicas com influencers 


O que você não vai fazer


Definir tese editorial (Founder escreve 1x/mês). Escrever roteiros de YouTube. Diagramar carrosséis (nossa designer faz). Gerenciar ads ou freelancers. Trabalhar com IA/Clone AI (fora do escopo).


Perfil


Obrigatório: mínimo 5 anos gerenciando Instagram profissional com comprovação verificável de perfis geridos (não aceitamos apenas link do perfil — precisa comprovar autoria real na Fase 1). Copywriting forte para redes sociais (você escreve, não adapta template). Confortável usando IA (Gemini/Claude) como apoio de produção. SEO básico de YouTube. Leitura de dashboard (Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio). Notion.

Essencial: execução inquebrável (100% de cadência, não 80%), atenção obsessiva a detalhe, baixo ego criativo, proatividade operacional, comunicação clara para passar briefing limpo para designer e editor.

Não aplique se: quer \"evoluir para estratégia\", precisa de flexibilidade criativa, ou precisa de micromanagement.


Remuneração


  • R$ 4.000/mês nos 60 dias de trial
  • R$ 6.000/mês após aprovação no gate Day 60
  • Bônus orgânico desde o Dia 1 (não-cumulativo por peça, exclui impulsionadas): 100k views = +R$100 · 500k views = +R$300 · 1M views = +R$3.000


Plano de carreira desenhado após Dia 120, baseado em evidência real de resultados.


Processo Seletivo


Fase 1 — Call breve com Head of CS (20min, não-paga). Fit cultural + filtro inicial. Você apresenta ao vivo 2-3 perfis de Instagram que gerenciou, com comprovação verificável (acesso admin no Meta Business Suite, menção pública do cliente, ou contrato). Sem comprovação = eliminação automática.

Fase 2 — Desafio tático pago (72h, R$200 a todos que entregarem). Plano de 14 dias para reverter o downranking ativo do @yuripereirario (dados reais compartilhados no briefing): diagnóstico + cronograma executável + copy + briefing de carrossel pilar + análise de 5 posts.

Fase 3 — Conversa + simulação ao vivo (45min com Founder + Growth Operations Manager). Fit cultural + simulação de cenário real.



Borderless Coding · Sede nos EUA (Wyoming) · Time remoto Brasil · EdTech global

Na Blocks, transformamos o setor de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção com soluções inovadoras baseadas no Revit. Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional que seja apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, comunicação e tendências do mercado, para ser a cara da Blocks nas redes sociais e na comunidade.

A Blocks é uma empresa de tecnologia, possui um software próprio e se dedica a digitalizar produtos reais em modelos 3D de alta qualidade, fornecendo ferramentas essenciais para otimizar os processos de trabalho de arquitetos, engenheiros e designers de interiores ao redor do mundo.

  • Experiência com redes sociais e estratégias de conteúdo digital

  • Day off no mês do aniversário, para você comemorar como quiser!

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?

Quem estamos buscando:

Profissionais experientes com mente empreendedora, postura de dono e atuação consultiva.

B2B Sales Partners do Grupo AG Capital contam com amplo treinamento sobre mercado e soluções, e nas reuniões com clientes é acompanhado do seu gestor comercial e profissionais da equipe técnica - com ampla estrutura tecnológica e time de suporte.

1. Desenvolvimento de novos negócios

4. Estratégia de venda consultiva

title: Data Platform Engineer (Pipelines & Vector Databases)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Platform Engineer (Pipelines & Vector Databases) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing technology company building scalable, data-intensive systems that power both product experiences and AI-driven capabilities. Their platform relies heavily on clean, structured, and reliable data to enable advanced features, automation, and intelligent decision-making.

They are investing in modern data infrastructure to support both core product functionality and emerging AI use cases , ensuring that data is accessible, accurate, and optimized for scale.


Role Overview

We are looking for a full-time (40 hours/week) Senior Data & AI Infrastructure Engineer to design and build the data backbone of our platform.

This role focuses on data pipelines, transformation, and infrastructure , ensuring that data from multiple sources is ingested, structured, and made reliable for both product and AI systems.

You will work in the EST time zone , collaborating with engineering teams to support scalable data systems and enable AI-driven functionality.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data pipelines across multiple sources
  • Design data processing, transformation, and storage systems
  • Create and maintain a canonical data layer
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability
  • Structure datasets for both product and AI use cases
  • Support vector databases and AI data workflows


Requirements

  • Strong experience in data engineering and pipeline development
  • Hands-on experience with Airflow, Dagster, dbt (or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling and transformation
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets
  • Ability to build scalable and reliable data systems


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, PgVector)
  • Familiarity with embeddings, retrieval systems, or AI data layers
  • Exposure to modern AI data tools (e.g., MindsDB)


What This Role Focuses On

  • Data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline reliability
  • Building structured, trusted datasets
  • Supporting AI and product systems with high-quality data


Key Traits

  • Strong attention to detail and data quality
  • Systems thinker with scalability mindset
  • Comfortable working with high-volume, complex data

title: Gerente de Inovação em Tecnologia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Inovação em Tecnologia em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Resumo da Função:

Buscamos um líder visionário e prático que respire Inovação para capitanear as oportunidades de transformação digital demandadas pelos nossos clientes e o mercado. O profissional irá definir soluções que utilizam o poder da Inteligência Artificial, a agilidade do Low-Code/No-Code para otimizar processos complexos, garantindo integrações fluidas e fluxos de trabalho eficientes.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Estratégia de Inovação: Liderar a adoção de tecnologias emergentes, com foco especial em IA Generativa e modelos preditivos aplicados ao negócio.
  • Desenvolvimento Ágil: Orquestrar o desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando ferramentas de Low-Code/No-Code para entregas rápidas e escaláveis.
  • Otimização de Processos: Mapear, desenhar e implementar fluxos de trabalho eficientes utilizando ferramentas de BPM e automação.
  • Integração de Ecossistemas: Garantir que diferentes sistemas conversem de forma harmoniosa.
  • Liderança Técnica: Atuar como líder da equipe, traduzindo desafios operacionais em especificações técnicas viáveis.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:


1. Inteligência Artificial & Data Science

  • Generative AI Service: Implementação de LLMs integrados às aplicações de negócio.
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Capacidade de conectar a IA aos dados proprietários da empresa para respostas precisas.
  • Serviços Cognitivos: Aplicação da inteligência artificial em tarefas como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional, análise de texto e tomada de decisão.
  • Agentes de IA: Desenvolvimento de Digital Assistants que automatizam o atendimento interno via BPM.


2. Integrações & Arquitetura

  • Integration: Criar fluxos ponta-a-ponta entre o ERP, bases on-premises e aplicações de terceiros.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Conhecimento em mensageria e gatilhos em tempo real para automação de processos.


3. Desenvolvimento Low-Code/No-Code

  • Criação de dashboards inteligentes e interfaces de usuário que consomem modelos de IA de forma nativa.
  • Foco em User Experience (UX) para garantir que a inovação seja adotada pelos usuários finais.
  • BPM e Workflow: Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de processos (BPMN 2.0) e ferramentas de automação de fluxo.


4. Plataformas

  • Experiência nos tópicos acima nas plataformas da Oracle e será um diferencial também na plataforma da Pipefy.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Inovação ou Transformação Digital.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de projetos de inovação tecnológica.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.
  • Habilidade em gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Inglês avançado para acompanhar tendências globais e parcerias internacionais.


Diferenciais:

  • Mindset Empreendedor: Capacidade de ver valor onde outros veem apenas processos.
  • Comunicação Influente: Habilidade para \"vender\" ideias de inovação para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Resiliência Técnica: Saber navegar pelas atualizações constantes do ecossistema cloud sem perder o foco na entrega.

O que oferecemos:

Atrativos de Infraestrutura e Autonomia:

  • Acesso a Sandbox: Acesso a um ambiente isolado para experimentação de novos serviços (IA, Blockchain, IoT) e preparação de PoCs.
  • Acesso Antecipado a Beta Programs: Participação em programas de Early Adopter para testar novas funcionalidades ou novos modelos de IA Generativa antes do lançamento geral.
  • Certificações e Eventos: Custeio de exames de certificação e ingressos para eventos locais.


Cultura de Inovação Prática:

  • Pesquisa: Estudo de novas tecnologias ou desenvolvimento de projetos paralelos que tragam eficiência à empresa.
  • Squads Multidisciplinares: Autonomia para montar times ágeis focados em \"missões\", unindo os diferentes perfis da equipe.


Benefícios de Carreira

  • Bônus por Resultado: Bônus anual atrelado aos resultados obtidos.
  • Trabalho Anywhere: Regime flexível de trabalho home-office/presencial.
  • Mentoria Executiva: Visibilidade direta com o C-Level para apresentar os resultados das iniciativas de inovação, posicionando o profissional como um líder estratégico.

Analista de Departamento Pessoal | Campinas, SP


DP bem feito não aparece — mas quando falha, todo mundo sente.

Por isso essa vaga importa. Estamos selecionando um Analista de DP para uma empresa parceira em Campinas, com contratação confidencial. Os detalhes sobre o cliente são compartilhados com os candidatos nas etapas avançadas do processo.

O dia a dia da função envolve:

  • Processamento de folha de pagamento e cálculos rescisórios;
  • Admissões e rescisões do início ao fim;
  • Controle de ponto eletrônico e gestão de benefícios (saúde, alimentação, transporte);
  • Cumprimento das obrigações trabalhistas e previdenciárias;
  • Manutenção dos registros em conformidade com a legislação vigente.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
    plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
    proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.

This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.

You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP
